primary.title: Filed ITR-4 last year? You might need to switch to ITR-3 in AY 2026-27 — here's why
primary.summary: Filing ITR-4 last year does not guarantee you can use the same form this year. Changes in income, business activity, investments, capital gains and other financial circumstances can affect eligibility. Taxpayers should check the key conditions before filing ITR-4 for AY 2026-27.
